comparator.name: Law
comparator.sourceNotes: The revised curriculum starts with 60 EC of required courses and separate zero-credit academic skills and language activities. Year two contains 55 EC of required courses and one 5 EC choice in law and technology. The regulations allocate 150 EC to requirements and restricted choices and 30 EC to open study across the degree. The revised third-year course allocation remains unpublished in the current Study Guide.
